surface.$description: Neutral elevation backgrounds — the grey container palette. Three levels only: page → card → raised. surface-6 is deliberately NOT here (it is a fill/outline color, see the fill/outline groups); use it as a background only for exceptions. Distinct from `bg` (which is the colored status/active tint washes, not neutral containers).

page.$description: The page background — the darkest surface everything sits on.

card.$description: Cards, popups, drawers, modals — the first elevation above the page.

raised.$description: Sub elements raised above a card — filled inputs, secondary buttons, chips, filled counters.

overlay.$description: The scrim behind modals/drawers — the page color at 50%.

default.$description: COMPAT alias → surface.card. Legacy name from the light-theme system; migrate to surface.card.

sunken.$description: COMPAT alias → surface.raised. In a dark system there is no 'sunken'; the recessed-field look is now surface.raised. Migrate.

disabled.$description: COMPAT alias → surface.card. Disabled surfaces should move to an opacity treatment (darken/lighten) in the component pass.

inverse.$description: COMPAT alias → surface.raised. There is no light/inverse surface in this dark system; Tooltip stands out via surface.raised + shadow. Migrate.

fill.$description: Solid brand/status fills for buttons, toggles, active markers. Hover/pressed are NOT separate tokens here — they are an opacity overlay (see darken/lighten), matching how the Theme Editor layers a translucent black/white sheet on top.

active.$description: The flat active fill — primary buttons, selected states, active markers, when NOT using the gradient.

activeGradient.$description: The active gradient — active-1 → active-2 at 90°. Primary buttons and outlines that opt into the gradient look; also reused as the border on hover states. Collapses to a flat color when active-1 = active-2 (as in Pro).

accent.$description: Solid accent fill — the secondary brand pop.

primary.$description: COMPAT alias → fill.active. 'primary' was the light-theme brand name; the primary interactive color here is the theme's active color. Migrate.

primaryHover.$description: COMPAT alias → fill.active. Hover is now a darken/lighten overlay, not a darker fill token. Migrate the component to overlay.

primaryActive.$description: COMPAT alias → fill.active. Pressed is now a darken overlay. Migrate.

neutral.$description: COMPAT alias → surface.raised. Neutral/secondary button fills are just the raised surface now. Migrate.

neutralHover.$description: COMPAT alias → surface.raised (+ lighten overlay in the component pass). Migrate.

neutralActive.$description: COMPAT alias → surface.raised (+ darken overlay in the component pass). Migrate.

disabled.$description: COMPAT alias → surface.raised. Disabled fills should move to an opacity treatment. Migrate.

bg.$description: Colored 12%-opacity tint washes — the pale status/active backgrounds behind chips, labels, selected rows. The color counterpart to the neutral `surface` group. Built on the sub-* opacity primitives, so they inherit the theme's active/accent/status hues automatically.

active.$description: Active tint — selected/active row or chip background, freebet.

accent.$description: Accent tint — the live label background.

neutral.$description: COMPAT alias → surface.raised. A neutral tag has no colored tint; it uses the raised surface. Migrate.

outline.$description: Border/hairline/outline colors. Two neutral weights (default = surface-4, strong = surface-6) plus the active/accent/status border colors. Renamed from the old `border` group.

default.$description: Default hairline — soft dividers and rest-state borders.

strong.$description: Strong border — outline-button borders, lines, emphasized dividers, hover borders.

active.$description: Active border — focus rings, selected outlines, active-tab underline.

border.$description: COMPAT group → all aliases to `outline`. The group was renamed border → outline; these keep current components resolving until the component pass migrates them.

focus.$description: COMPAT alias → outline.active. The focus ring is the active color now. Migrate.

text.$description: Text colors. default/secondary are the two greys; contrast is dark text for placing ON a light/contrast surface; forActiveBg is text placed on an active-colored fill (dark or white depending on how bright the theme's active color is).

default.$description: Default body text — max contrast (white) on the dark surfaces.

contrast.$description: Contrast text — dark text for the rare light/contrast surface.

forActiveBg.$description: Text placed on an active-colored fill. In Pro the active color is bright orange, so this is dark (surface-0); in a theme with a dark active color it flips to white. Theme-dependent — see the deferred text.forLabelBg for the label equivalent.

active.$description: Active text — links, active tab labels, active values.

positive.$description: Positive text — winnings, gains, positive odds movement.

negative.$description: Negative text — losses, errors, negative odds movement.

onFill.$description: Text on a dark solid fill (e.g. the Tooltip). For text on the ACTIVE fill use text.forActiveBg instead.

muted.$description: COMPAT alias → text.secondary. There is one muted grey; muted collapses into secondary. Migrate.

disabled.$description: COMPAT alias → text.secondary. Disabled text should move to an opacity treatment. Migrate.

icon.$description: Icon colors — mirrors `text`. default is contrast (white) for content icons; use icon.secondary for chrome/field icons.

secondary.$description: Secondary/chrome icons — field icons, close ×, info circles.

contrast.$description: Dark icon for a light/contrast surface.

onFill.$description: Icon on a dark solid fill.

betStatus.$description: My-bets settlement statuses. win/loose/cashout reuse the editable positive/negative/warning; halfWin/halfLoose/refund/pending use the four file-only extra status hues (color-4..7). These are the colored dots/labels on a bet row.

label.$description: Small inline labels/badges on cards and rows. Some are colored tints (live/freebet), some solid status (postponed/reviewing), plus the score chip and the two counter states. NOTE: a dedicated text.forLabelBg (light/dark per theme, deferred) will handle text ON these label backgrounds.

freebet.$description: Freebet — active tint. (In some themes this is the accent tint; Pro uses active.)

score.$description: Score chip background — one of the sanctioned surface-6-as-background exceptions.

inactiveCounter.$description: Inactive counter background — a faint lighten wash.

activeCounter.$description: Active counter background — the active color.

darken.$description: Translucent black overlays (built on the page color) laid OVER an element to darken it — pressed states, and the darker half of hover treatments. In code this is an rgba layer / alpha change, not a color swap. Steps 2/4/6/8 = 12/24/50/80%.

lighten.$description: Translucent white overlays laid OVER an element to lighten it — hover states on dark surfaces. In code this is an rgba layer / alpha change. Steps 2/4 = 12/24%.

2.$description: Lighten 12% — the default hover overlay on dark surfaces.

shadow.$description: Shadow colors — the same page-color black steps as `darken`, used as box-shadow colors rather than overlays. Steps 2/4/6/8 = 12/24/50/80%.

additional.$description: One-off semantic roles that do not fit the groups above.

preloader.$description: Loading spinner/skeleton accent — the active color.

status.$description: COMPAT group → aliases into fill. The old system exposed a `status` group that fill.* referenced; kept so nothing dangles until the component pass. Migrate to fill.positive/negative/warning/accent.
